/**
   * Called when an alert from a protocol level implementation is generated.
   *
   * @param message - The localized message string to alert.
   * @param serverKey - The key of the server to with this error.
   * @param silent - If true, this method will notify listeners (so they can
   *   e.g. store the alert in the activity manager) but will not result in a
   *   visible alert to the user. This can be needed for background operations
   *   where we don't want to notify the user in the same way as "normal"
   *   operations.
   * @returns True if the alert was serviced and it does not need to be
   *   prompted to the user separately.
   */
  boolean onAlert(in AString message, in ACString serverKey, in boolean silent);

  /**
   * Call to inform the listeners of a certificate error. The listener should
   * alert the user about the error and (if appropriate) allow the user to add
   * a certificate override.
   *
   * @param securityInfo - The security information about the operation.
   * @param uri - URI which is relevant to the operation.
   * @param serverKey - The key of the server to with this error.
   */
  void onCertError(in nsITransportSecurityInfo securityInfo,
                   in nsIURI url,
                   in ACString serverKey);
